newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to edge down towards 4,670.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to edge down towards 4,670.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will edge a little lower on Wednesday to around 4,670, technical analysts said.
Its march towards higher ground has been blunted after a winning streak of 11 consecutive days closing higher so it would be normal for shares to retreat a little, they added.

Short-term osillators for the FTSE -- such as its 10 day momentum -- indicate the market is extremely overbought but with the underlying trend still poisitive it will be difficult for market bears to exploit the situation too much.
By 0725 GMT, the FTSE was indicated down 7.4 at 4,683.6.
Investor sentiment usually turns cautious once the market reaches or overshoots a nice round number -- such as 4,700 on the FTSE yesterday, analysts said.
Uncertainty about just how soon and by how much interest rates in the U.S. and UK will have to rise will dampen enthusiasm for shares over the short-term although volatility may creep in later.
But, considering the market has shot up about 320 points, or seven percent, in 11 days a small amount of backtraking will not dent overall positive sentiment.
